title: Death In The Box Codes (July 2026)
description: Working Death In The Box codes for free in-game rewards. Updated regularly.

Open the codes or redeem menu in the game UI.
Paste a working code exactly as shown.

faq.q: Are these Death In The Box codes free?
faq.a: Yes. Promo codes unlock free in-game rewards when they are still active.

faq.q: Why did a Death In The Box code not work?
faq.a: It is usually expired, mistyped, or already redeemed on your account.

faq.q: How often are Death In The Box codes updated?
faq.a: We refresh this page when new codes drop or old ones expire. Check the Updated date above.
